sentences.text:
Kuldeep Singh Khaira vs State Of Punjab And Others on 15
March, 2013
Bench: Jasbir Singh, Inderjit Singh

In the High Court of Punjab and Haryana, at Chandigarh
 Civil Writ Petition No. 5542 of 2013
 Date of Decision: 15.3.2013
Kuldeep Singh Khaira
 ... Petitioner
 Versus
State of Punjab and Others
 ... Respondents
Coram: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Jasbir Singh.
Hon'ble Mr. Justice Inderjit Singh Present: Mr. Sardavinder Goyal, Advocate for the petitioner.

entities.text: High Court of Punjab and Haryana, at Chandigarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By filing this writ petition, a prayer has been made that directions be issued to the respondents to implement the provisions of Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and Food Safety and Standard Rules, 2011 in its true letter and spirit.
It is further prayed that directions be issued to appoint a whole-time designated officer in each district of the State, as per the provisions of the above Act and Rules.

It is grievance of the petitioner that at present, above powers have been given to the officers who are already over burdened and on account of that very purpose of the above Act and Rules is being defeated.

At the time of arguments, it transpires that the petitioner has already sent his representation dated 24.4.2012 (Annexure P3) to respondent No.2-Principal Secretary, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Punjab, which is still pending undecided.

entities.text: Principal Secretary, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Punjab
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: Taking note of the facts and circumstances of the case, we dispose of this writ petition by issuing directions to the above said officer to take note of grievance of the petitioner, as stated in the above representation (Annexure P3) and pass an appropriate order.
If appointment of an independent designated Officer is required, the same shall be done as per the provisions of law.
Needful shall be done within two months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.

(Jasbir Singh) Judge (Inderjit Singh) Judge March 15, 2013 "DK"
